author: 263marau

title: Wonderfully tailored tour of Barcelona!!
text: Personalized and amazing. Federico coordinated a wonderful walking and driving tour based exactly on what my wife and I wanted. He reached out two weeks prior to initiate contact and gather some details. We changed things on him the morning of the tour since we saw something on our own that he was going to show us. He was very accommodating and modified the itinerary to show us exactly what we were looking for. We could not have been happier…this tour, Federico, and Barcelona were amazing! Thank you!
author: Ryan_W

title: Top Notch Experience
text:
Our first contact with Federico was very positive, as he always responded quickly to our messages and provided good information, whether it was answers to our questions or making useful suggestions. He was always flexible in order to provide us what we wanted from our tours.

Meeting him and touring with him only increased our initial good feelings.  Importantly, he has excellent English and is very easy to hear and understand.  He kept to our pace and was extremely knowledgeable.

Overall, Federico provided two days of touring Barcelona that were as excellent as we hoped for.
